title: castanopsis cuspidata var. longicaudata
intro: Castanopsis cuspidata var. longicaudata, commonly known as Chinese chestnut, is a plant species in the beech family (Fagaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Castanopsis cuspidata var. longicaudata may include pain relief, fever reduction, and improved immune function. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
